lastCompletedStory.title: Audit security/secrets, license/repo-visibility, and telemetry/privacy dimensions

nextStoryContext: docs/launch-readiness.md now has all 6 dimensions from US-001+US-002 (distribution/install: gap, first-run onboarding: gap, external-facing docs: gap, security/secrets: gap, license/repo-visibility: ready, telemetry/privacy stance: gap), each with a same-line Verdict Summary table row and a full prose section below the table -- US-003 appends the final two dimensions (versioning/release/update, support channels) using the identical convention, then closes the report with a prioritized triage across ALL 8 dimensions, a go/no-go recommendation, and a Follow-up Issues section (ready-to-file specs in the worker report, NOT hand-filed as scripts/cam/issues/CAM-XXXX.json on this branch -- per the CAM-162 defect rule, that add/add-collision risk means US-003's deliverable is specs for the orchestrator/operator to file on main afterward). IMPORTANT for US-003's triage: license/repo-visibility is the one dimension marked 'ready', not 'gap' -- don't force it into the gap-triage list, but DO carry forward its two explicitly non-blocking pending items (GitHub repo rename cam-cli->cam-runtime, still CAM-329's separate GH-side operator step; missing SECURITY.md/CONTRIBUTING.md/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) into the follow-up-issues list, since 'ready' doesn't mean 'nothing left to track'. Also: security/secrets found the single most launch-relevant fact in the whole report so far -- cam-dispatched claude sessions default to permission_mode=bypassPermissions (src/config/permission-mode.ts) with zero README disclosure -- weight that heavily in the go/no-go and triage priority. US-002 also corrected 3 factual errors US-001 had written (repo falsely called 'private and unpublished' in two places; CAM-332 falsely called 'still open' when scripts/cam/issues/CAM-0332.json already reads stage:shipped) -- verified directly via `gh api repos/eduardocaminha/cam-cli` and `jq '.stage' scripts/cam/issues/CAM-0332.json` rather than trusting inherited PRD-notes premises; re-verify any other stale-sounding claim in the doc rather than assuming it, same discipline applies to US-003's own writing.
